name: @pipeworx/mcp-citybikes

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Browse all bike-sharing networks worldwide. Returns network name, ID, city, country, and coordinates for each network.

tools.name: get_network
tools.description: Check live bike availability at stations in a specific network (e.g., "citi-bike-nyc"). Returns station locations, available bikes, and empty slots.

tools.name: search_networks
tools.description: Find bike-sharing networks by city or country name. Returns matching networks with their locations and IDs.

query.description: City or country name to search for (e.g. "New York", "France", "Berlin")

tools.name: citybikes_networks_near
tools.description: Find bike-share networks near a lat/lon: "bike share near me", "find bike rental network by location", "citybikes nearby coordinates". Returns the closest networks sorted by distance with their id, name, city, country, and distance_km. If none fall within radius_km, returns count:0 plus a note naming the single nearest network beyond the radius. To then get live stations and free bikes for a returned network, call get_network with its id. Example: Göttingen (latitude 51.53, longitude 9.93) → nextbike-kassel ~39.5km away.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (default 50; bike networks are sparse, so the nearest city may be 30km+ away)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-citybikes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the citybikes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
